title: Grand Theft Auto VI
scope: What Grand Theft Auto VI is: the official premise, release date, platforms, editions and price, and the Leonida setting with Lucia and Jason. Only facts stated in the extracts. Do not invent gameplay systems, a PC release, or online features.

title: Release date and earlier announcements
scope: The current official release date of November 19, 2026, and the earlier official dates Rockstar announced (a 2025 window, then May 26, 2026). State each date as what Rockstar announced at the time, and which announcement is current. Do not speculate about further delays.

title: Platforms
scope: Platforms Rockstar has announced for Grand Theft Auto VI: PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, including PS5 Pro Enhanced if stated, Xbox Cloud Gaming on Xbox One and Series, and that it is not available on PlayStation 4 if an extract says so. Do not add a PC version unless an extract says Rockstar announced one.

title: PC version
scope: Whether Rockstar has officially announced a PC version. Official extracts list PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S only. If an editorial extract states that Rockstar has not announced a PC version, you may say that. Do not state estimated PC dates, insider claims, or rumors, even if they appear in an extract.

title: System requirements
scope: What official sources say about hardware needed to play. There is no official PC version announcement in the preferred sources, so do not invent PC specs. Cover announced consoles (PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S) and any cloud-streaming notes, including Xbox Wire's note that cloud play uses Series S graphics settings if present. If official extracts give pre-load storage guidance, mention it and point readers to the file-size page rather than inventing PC or per-console installed sizes.

title: Price and editions
scope: The Standard Edition and Ultimate Edition, their official US prices ($79.99 and $99.99) if stated, what each includes at a summary level, and that an Ultimate Edition Upgrade can be bought later. Leave item-by-item Ultimate contents to the Ultimate Edition page.

title: Pre-orders
scope: When pre-orders opened (June 25, 2026, midnight local time), where to pre-order, and which bonuses apply to pre-orders and purchases before November 20, 2026 (Vintage Vice City Pack; a month of GTA+ for eligible digital purchases). Do not invent retailer-exclusive bonuses.

title: Pre-load
scope: When digital pre-loading began or begins: PlayStation 5 at midnight local time on November 10, 2026, and Xbox Series X|S at 12 a.m. GMT on November 10, 2026, as official support and later Newswire posts state. If an earlier Take-Two extract says November 12, treat that as a disagreement with the later official dates, not as a fact to pick. Mention that pre-loading is for people who have pre-ordered if the extracts say so. If official or platform-holder extracts give free-storage guidance for pre-load (for example a minimum of 212 GB on PlayStation 5), include that figure as free space to have, not as a final per-platform installed size.

knownConflicts.heading: Digital pre-load date
knownConflicts.sentence: Official sources have given more than one date for when digital pre-loading would begin.

positions.quote: digital pre-load begins at midnight local time in your respective time zone on November 10, 2026

title: File size and storage
scope: Official free-space guidance for pre-loading Grand Theft Auto VI. PlayStation tells players to clear a minimum of 212 GB of storage on PlayStation 5 to pre-load. State that official pages are giving storage to have free, not necessarily a final per-platform installed size. Do not treat unofficial download-size estimates as fact. Do not invent a PlayStation versus Xbox installed size if extracts do not give one. If a Rockstar extract states a storage figure, you may use that wording; do not attribute press wording to Rockstar. Mention pre-load timing only as the extracts state it.

title: Physical edition
scope: The boxed physical version: it contains a download code rather than a disc, becomes available starting November 12 to support pre-loading, includes the Vintage Vice City Pack as described, and has no physical Ultimate Edition. Cover region notes only if the support extract states them.

title: Where to buy
scope: Official storefronts named for buying or pre-ordering: PlayStation Store, Microsoft Store, Rockstar Games Store, and global retailers, plus any official notes about buying in the same region as a platform account.

title: Age rating and content descriptors
scope: Content descriptors published on official Grand Theft Auto VI pages (Blood and Gore, Intense Violence, Mature Humor, Nudity, Strong Language, Strong Sexual Content, Use of Drugs and Alcohol). Only state an ESRB or other board's letter rating if an extract actually gives one. Do not carry forward an older 'not yet rated' line if later official pages no longer say that, and if extracts disagree, put the disagreement in conflicts.

title: Story
scope: The official premise only: Jason and Lucia, an easy score that goes wrong, a criminal conspiracy across the state of Leonida, Vice City as the sunniest place in America's darkest side, and that they must rely on each other. Do not invent mission names, plot twists, or endings.

title: Characters
scope: The characters Rockstar has introduced with official bios: Lucia Caminos, Jason Duval, Cal Hampton, Boobie Ike, Dre'Quan Priest, Real Dimez (Bae-Luxe and Roxy), Raul Bautista, and Brian Heder, plus named associates only if the extracts name them (Lori, DWNPLY). Short introductions; leave full bios to child pages.

title: Lucia Caminos
scope: Lucia Caminos as described on the official site: her father taught her to fight, fighting for her family landed her in the Leonida Penitentiary, sheer luck got her out, she wants the good life her mom dreamed of since their days in Liberty City, and a life with Jason could be her way out.

title: Jason Duval
scope: Jason Duval as described on the official site: he grew up around grifters and crooks, served a stint in the Army, works for local drug runners in the Keys, wants an easy life, and meeting Lucia could be the best or worst thing to happen to him.

title: Cal Hampton
scope: Cal Hampton as described officially: Jason's friend and a fellow associate of Brian's, who feels safest hanging at home, snooping on Coast Guard comms, described as casually paranoid, at the low tide of America.

title: Boobie Ike
scope: Boobie Ike as described officially: a local Vice City legend with a legitimate empire spanning real estate, a strip club, and a recording studio, and his partnership with Dre'Quan for Only Raw Records.

title: Dre'Quan Priest
scope: Dre'Quan Priest as described officially: more of a hustler than a gangster, breaking into music was the goal, he booked acts into Boobie's strip club, and he has signed the Real Dimez to Only Raw Records.

title: Real Dimez
scope: Real Dimez as described officially: Bae-Luxe and Roxy, friends since high school, spicy rap tracks and a social media presence, an early hit with local rapper DWNPLY, and now signed to Only Raw Records after five years.

title: Raul Bautista
scope: Raul Bautista as described officially: a seasoned bank robber always on the hunt for talent, confidence, charm and cunning, whose recklessness raises the stakes with every score. Mention Ambrosia only if an extract ties him to it.

title: Brian Heder
scope: Brian Heder as described officially: a classic drug runner from the golden age of smuggling in the Keys, still moving product through his boat yard with his third wife Lori, letting Jason live rent-free at one of his properties in exchange for help with local shakedowns.

title: Leonida
scope: The fictional state of Leonida as official sources describe it: home to Vice City and beyond, the sunshine state setting of the story, and named places official pages point to (Vice City, the Keys, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, Leonida Penitentiary) only when the extracts name them. Do not invent a map, city list, or real-world one-to-one Florida identifications.

title: Vice City
scope: Vice City, USA, as official sources describe it: neon-soaked streets, the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, and the city where several announced characters operate. Do not import details from earlier Grand Theft Auto games unless an extract explicitly ties them to this game.

title: The Keys
scope: The Keys as official character bios describe them: where Jason works for local drug runners after the Army, and where Brian Heder still moves product through his boat yard. Do not invent a full Keys map or town list.

title: Port Gellhorn
scope: Port Gellhorn only as official pages name or introduce it (including any 'Explore Port Gellhorn' context on character pages). Do not invent geography, businesses, or a role in the plot beyond the extracts.

title: Ambrosia
scope: Ambrosia only as official pages name or introduce it (including any 'Explore Ambrosia' context on character pages). Do not invent geography or a plot role beyond the extracts.

title: Map and setting
scope: What official sources have actually said about the map and setting: Vice City and the state of Leonida, plus named places in official text (the Keys, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, and any neighborhoods or landmarks named in official edition or site copy such as Washington Beach, Shore Drive, Gambit Bay, Mount Kalaga, or Watson Bay). Do not claim Rockstar has published a full map unless an extract says so, and do not treat fan reconstructions as fact.

title: Gameplay
scope: Gameplay details official text actually states: that Grand Theft Auto VI is presented as a single-player experience, the official premise, and any concrete features named in official or platform-holder extracts (for example PS5 Pro Enhanced, Remote Play, offline play, or Xbox Cloud Gaming). Do not invent wanted levels, ability lists, or mission types. If the extracts are thin, write a short page rather than padding.

title: Trailers and videos
scope: The official videos Rockstar has released, with their official titles and dates: Trailer 1 (December 4 or 5, 2023 as the extracts state), Trailer 2 (May 6, 2025), An Extended Look (August 27, 2026, including Netflix and YouTube if stated), the Launch Trailer (October 15, 2026), and the pre-load video if mentioned. Leave detailed contents to child pages. If dates disagree by a day, put that in conflicts.

title: Trailer 1
scope: Official Trailer 1: when Rockstar published it, that it announced the game, and any setting or character names the Trailer 1 Newswire or official site attributes to that reveal. Do not narrate unlisted trailer shots as a shot list unless an official extract describes them.

title: Trailer 2
scope: Official Trailer 2, published May 6, 2025: the official invitation to explore Vice City and beyond, and any official description of the story hook (an easy score, a conspiracy across Leonida) if the extracts include it.

title: An Extended Look
scope: Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look. Official announcement that it would arrive August 27 on Netflix and YouTube, the later 'now playing' post, any official description of runtime or that it was captured from in-game PlayStation 5 footage, and that Rockstar presented it as a look at the game rather than a shot-by-shot fan transcript.

title: Launch trailer
scope: The official Launch Trailer dated October 15, 2026, including the debut of 'Flower in a Hurricane' from original score composers Justice featuring Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard if the extracts state that.

title: Radio and soundtrack
scope: Official music announcements: in-game radio stations (including any count or 'Leonida Radio' and podcasts if stated), Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album coming November 19 with the official track count and singles, and a short pointer to the original score page. Do not invent station or track lists beyond the extracts.

title: Original score
scope: The official original score announcement: Justice as composers, the album date if stated (December 11 in the Newswire title or body), and 'Flower in a Hurricane' featuring Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard if the extracts name them.

title: Ultimate Edition
scope: What official sources say the Ultimate Edition includes: the game plus the Ultimate Edition Upgrade, the official $99.99 price, that bonuses are threaded across Jason and Lucia's story and uncovered behind each chapter, the official item list from Rockstar support and the PlayStation Store listing, that Standard owners can buy the upgrade later, and that a physical Ultimate Edition is not available.

title: Vintage Vice City Pack
scope: The Vintage Vice City Pack: who gets it (pre-orders and purchases before November 20, 2026, including physical pre-orders as described), and the official contents: '55 Vapid Stanier Sedan and Garage, outfits and hairstyles, and an exclusive weapon pattern. Note that a free month of GTA+ is listed with digital editions, and say whether the support article groups it with the pack or as a separate digital bonus if the wording is specific.

title: GTA+ offer
scope: The official GTA+ offer tied to digital pre-orders or purchases of Grand Theft Auto VI: one month of GTA+, claim deadlines and auto-renewal notes if the store or support extracts state them, and that GTA+ is described in connection with GTA Online and the GTA+ Games Library, including Grand Theft Auto V, where those extracts say so. Do not describe a Grand Theft Auto VI online mode unless an extract does.

title: Xbox Cloud Gaming
scope: Official Xbox and related notes: Grand Theft Auto VI can be played on day one through Xbox Cloud Gaming on Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S, start time if stated (1 a.m. ET on November 19), that cloud play uses Xbox Series S graphics settings, and that the game must be purchased separately. Do not invent PC cloud support.

title: PlayStation features
scope: PlayStation-specific official details: PlayStation 5 and PS5 Pro Enhanced if stated, that the game is not on PlayStation 4 if the PlayStation page says so, pre-load timing on PS5, and any listed features such as Remote Play, offline play, or player count. Cover the 'Plays Best On PlayStation 5' line only as marketing text on official pages, not as a technical comparison you invent.

title: GTA Online
scope: What official sources actually say about online play in connection with Grand Theft Auto VI. Preferred extracts describe Grand Theft Auto VI as a single-player experience and mention GTA+ / GTA Online in the context of the existing service and Games Library. Do not announce a Grand Theft Auto VI multiplayer or a GTA Online sequel unless an extract explicitly does so. If official sources are silent on a VI online mode, do not fill the gap.

title: Cross-play
scope: Whether official sources have announced a cross-play feature for Grand Theft Auto VI. Official listings describe Grand Theft Auto VI as a single-player experience. Official sources have not announced a VI cross-play feature or a VI multiplayer mode. State what official extracts say, and that a cross-play feature has not been announced. Do not invent a Rockstar "no" as a quotation. Do not treat GTA Online's historical lack of cross-play as a fact about VI unless an official VI extract says so. Do not use rumors or partner quotes to fill that silence.
